display_name: Section 1 — British citizenship by birth or adoption in the United Kingdom
versions_encoded: Section 1 in its current consolidated text, as in force on 2026-07-04 (bna.l4:11). No rule-version axis: the pre-2002, pre-2010 and pre-2021 texts are not encoded (bna.l4:28-29). Three dated constants carry the section's own dates: commencement (1 January 1983), the appointed day (21 May 2002) and the relevant day (13 January 2010).
scope: Section 1 of the British Nationality Act 1981 — subsections (1), (1A), (2), (3), (3A), (4), (5), (5A), (6) and (7) as predicates, (8) as a pointer to s 50 carried on an input field's @ref, (9) as a dated constant (bna.l4:13-22). OUT OF SCOPE: the s 50(2)-(5) construction of 'settled', the registration process, and the HFEA parental-order modifications; each arrives as an already-construed input fact. Encoded de novo as the demo pipeline's smoke-test subject, 'as is traditional' (Sergot et al., CACM 29(5), 1986). Twelve interpretive ambiguities are recorded at their sites as `-- AMBIGUITY:` comments and tabled in README.md. projections/ holds the DMN 1.3 export, its fidelity reports and 25 engine cases. report/SMOKE-REPORT.md is the hand-driven run that became the go orchestrator's requirements. 42 assertions, none failing, with four goldens.

not_reviewed.note: No HG1 grant or waiver was found for this encoding in legalese/l4-ide, where it was written.
